content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary objective lacks estimand specification",
      "quote": "To assess whether pralsetinib improves PFS compared with investigator’s choice of SOC platinum-containing anticancer treatment regimens",
      "page": 35,
      "section": "3.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The primary objective is stated but no estimand (population, variable, intercurrent events, summary measure) is defined, which is required by ICH M11 and SPIRIT 2025.",
      "fix": "Add a formal estimand section specifying the target population, endpoint definition, handling of intercurrent events (e.g., treatment switching, discontinuation), and population-level summary measure."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent number of SOC regimens",
      "quote": "Participants randomized to the chemotherapy arm (Arm B) will receive one of six SOC platinum-containing anticancer treatment regimens",
      "page": 12,
      "section": "1.1",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The synopsis states 'one of six SOC' regimens, but the text lists four non-squamous and three squamous regimens, totaling seven. This discrepancy could confuse site staff and affect protocol implementation.",
      "fix": "Correct the number to 'seven' or revise the list to match the stated number."
    },
    {
      "title": "Premature termination not reflected in objectives",
      "quote": "The Sponsor has decided to prematurely terminate the study due to Blueprint Medicines' decision to discontinue global marketing and development of pralsetinib",
      "page": 12,
      "section": "1.1",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The protocol states the study is prematurely terminated, yet the objectives and endpoints still describe a full comparative efficacy analysis. This inconsistency may lead to confusion about whether the primary analysis will be conducted as planned.",
      "fix": "Add a statement in the objectives or statistical section clarifying how the premature termination affects the analysis (e.g., descriptive only) and update the primary objective accordingly."
    },
    {
      "title": "No trial stopping rules defined",
      "quote": "The Sponsor has decided to prematurely terminate the study due to Blueprint Medicines' decision to discontinue global marketing and development of pralsetinib",
      "page": 12,
      "section": "4.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol mentions premature termination but does not provide formal trial stopping rules (e.g., for futility, safety, or administrative reasons) as required by ICH M11 section 4.3.",
      "fix": "Add a subsection on trial stopping rules, including criteria for early termination and the process for notifying investigators and regulators."
    },
    {
      "title": "Contraception requirements not specified",
      "quote": "Participants randomized to pralsetinib (Arm A) or participants originally randomized to Arm B who cross over will receive 400 mg pralsetinib by mouth once a day.",
      "page": 12,
      "section": "5.4.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not describe contraception requirements for participants of childbearing potential, which is essential for a study involving an investigational drug with potential teratogenicity.",
      "fix": "Add a detailed contraception requirements section, including acceptable methods, duration, and specific requirements for males and females."
    },
    {
      "title": "No description of non-investigational interventions",
      "quote": "Participants should receive pemetrexed 500mg/m2 followed by carboplatin to target area under the concentration-time curve (AUC) of 5 mg • min/mL both on Day 1 every 3 weeks (Q3W) for 4 or 6 cycles",
      "page": 12,
      "section": "6.9",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The protocol describes the SOC chemotherapy regimens but does not explicitly list them as non-investigational interventions or provide details on their supply, administration, or modification rules beyond a general statement.",
      "fix": "Add a section describing non-investigational interventions, including their role, administration, and any restrictions."
    },
    {
      "title": "No interim analysis details",
      "quote": "The Sponsor has decided to prematurely terminate the study due to Blueprint Medicines' decision to discontinue global marketing and development of pralsetinib",
      "page": 12,
      "section": "10.9",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not describe any planned interim analyses, including the timing, stopping boundaries, or the role of the independent Data Monitoring Committee, which is critical for a Phase III study.",
      "fix": "Add an interim analysis section detailing whether any interim analyses were planned, their timing, and the statistical methods used."
    },
    {
      "title": "No data sharing statement",
      "quote": "The Sponsor has decided to prematurely terminate the study due to Blueprint Medicines' decision to discontinue global marketing and development of pralsetinib",
      "page": 12,
      "section": "SPIRIT 6",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The protocol lacks a data sharing statement, which is required by SPIRIT 2025 and many funders and journals.",
      "fix": "Add a data sharing section describing whether and how de-identified participant data will be shared, with whom, and under what conditions."
    }
  ]
}
